feedback.end: Buttercups are one of the most well-known meadow flowers. If you hold a buttercup under your chin, your chin will get a yellow glow.
Daisies grow in nearly every meadow. If you tie the stems of daisies together, you can make a daisy chain.
Poppies grew on the battlefields after the First World War. They are now used as a symbol of peace and remembrance.
Cornflowers are important sources of nectar for butterflies. Cornflowers can be used to make food colouring.
